title: Deadly Premonition Origins
synopsis: SWERY’s cult open-world mystery in its original form — retained as Aksys Games’ Nintendo Switch game card.

curatorNotes:
Deadly Premonition, directed by SWERY at Access Games, sends FBI Agent Francis York Morgan to the town of Greenvale to investigate the Raincoat Killer. It first released on Xbox 360 in February 2010 and became a cult classic for its eccentric mix of horror, small-town life, and open-world routine.

Origins is the original version, not the later Director’s Cut. It released on the Nintendo Switch eShop on September 4, 2019, and Aksys Games issued the North American physical edition that December.

This filing opens the Deadly Premonition lineage on the shelf.
collectionNotes:
The retained object is Aksys Games’ North American retail edition of Deadly Premonition Origins on a Nintendo Switch game card.

Dedicated artifact views of the individual copy have not yet been filed; the gallery below is held open for that documentation.

preservation.playableOn: Nintendo Switch; compatible Nintendo Switch family hardware
preservation.compatibility: Nintendo Switch software is region-free. The retained game card is the primary access copy and runs on any Nintendo Switch console.
preservation.concerns: Game cards are flash media; long-term charge retention, contact wear, and loss of the small card from its case are the principal risks. Any content delivered as an eShop download or update depends on Nintendo’s servers and is not preserved by the card alone.
preservation.knownRevisions: Original Xbox 360 release in February 2010; the Director’s Cut followed in 2013. Origins released on the Nintendo Switch eShop on September 4, 2019; the Aksys physical edition (HAC-P-AVGWC) followed in December 2019.
preservation.availability: Distributed at retail by Aksys Games, with a digital edition on the Nintendo eShop.
